results.title: Asking for a Friend
results.overview: Henry Ball, a struggling background actor, befriends outcast members of a friendship support group to help him navigate his new romantic relationship with an adult film star.

results.title: SB19 'Simula at Wakas' World Tour Kickoff Concert Film
results.original_title: SB19 'Simula at Wakas' World Tour Kickoff Concert Film
results.overview: One stage. Five voices. Countless stories waiting to be told. Witness SB19's Simula at Wakas World Tour Kickoff Concert like never before. Step back into the Philippine Arena and experience an immersive concert film that brings the music and the memories of two unforgettable nights to the big screen.

results.title: Emergent City
results.overview: When global developers purchase Industry City — a series of connected industrial buildings within a primarily immigrant, working class community in Brooklyn — conflicting views draw battlelines between residents, city officials and master planners as the fate of the city and contemporary urban development hangs in the balance.

results.title: Closed Broken Windows
results.overview: The Poet’s dream, in which he moves through cityscapes, endless corridors, and rows of repetitive window bars—reciting his own verses and wandering through his own thoughts—while visualizing mental constraints and the "closed windows" that isolate him from the true, sincere love lying just beyond them.

results.title: Strindbergs Ensam
results.overview: Based on Strindberg's autobiographical book of the same name. Is it better to self isolate than to put in all the work it takes to maintain a social life?

results.title: The Sale
results.overview: It’s 1993 and Sita has recently immigrated to California. She is desperate to make an encyclopedia sale as a first step to learning how to sell and starting her own business. Her lack of commissions have cost her family comfort and weigh heavily on her.  As pressure mounts, she goes out to her 3 leads for the day and attempts to make a sale. Met with frustration, fear and humiliation, she fights every urge to give up.

results.title: So Long Pluto
results.overview: In space, a charming little planet named Pluto dreams of joining the Solar System’s official dance troupe. With the help of her asteroid friend, Ceres, and her human discoverer, Clyde William Tombaugh, she will do everything she can to make it happen. In this children’s film, where humans and planets share the spotlight, viewers will accompany Pluto on her quest for fame, until the moment she must face her destiny.

results.title: Invisible Injuries
results.overview: After war, Australian veteran Andy Fermo returned home carrying invisible wounds. Invisible Injuries explores PTSD's impact on identity, family and daily life, and the courage it takes to heal, reconnect and keep moving forward.

results.title: Lovers in the Blue Night
results.overview: Set against the margins of Mumbai, the film follows four migrants – a gay husband, his wife working in a bar, a thief, and a pimp – whose lives converge around love, survival, and longing

results.title: The Shadow of the Sun
results.overview: A father attempts to repair his relationship with his estranged son, but his criminal past catches up and threatens to tear them apart.

results.title: >1,5°C Pyropolitics and the New World
results.overview: The devastating forest fires in Los Angeles are described in three acts.

results.title: The Actor
results.overview: A young actor attempts to finish their self audition tape. But a series of never ending interruptions sends him into an existential spiral.

results.title: Pain
results.overview: March 8th, stand-up club. Ira's performance immediately goes awry: her ex is in the audience with his new girlfriend. And an intoxicated audience member decides to interfere with the evening's program. It gradually becomes increasingly difficult to discern where the show ends and real life begins.

results.title: GAMALAND
results.original_title: 沢田美由紀のガマランドにお邪魔します

results.title: Crash
results.overview: The film follows a day's work at the BMW Recycling and Dismantling Center in Munich, documenting step-by-step the final stage of a car's dismantling process.

results.title: Keep
results.overview: As debt collectors close in, a young boy steals what's left of his home.

results.title: Monica's News
results.overview: Set in 1974 in the fictional village of Millman, Monica's News follows a nine-year-old girl who finds independence in her paper route, but ends up witnessing a tragic event.

results.title: Boy Trouble
results.overview: When Britney’s friends suspect her boyfriend might be a serial killer, she laughs it off—until she can’t.

results.title: Vicente na Cidade Fantasma
results.overview: On All Souls’ Day, little Vicente is left behind by his absent-minded parents on a deserted road and, by chance, discovers a city entirely in black and white, where the dead return once a year to reunite. With them, the boy learns about life, death, and the value of true friendship. But to see his parents again, Vicente will have to overcome the powerful Guardians of Time.

results.title: Flux
results.overview: Brian Espinosa is a young, troubled man who has had more than his share of police contact. When his longtime girlfriend, Melody, overdoses, Brian enlists the help of his best friend, Sarah. When Sarah arrives, Melody has miraculously returned, yet she is not quite herself. Detectives Madsen and Slater are en route to apprehend Brian on a criminal warrant.
